SQLite upstream documents the WAL-reset corruption bug through 3.51.2 and the fix in 3.51.3+, so 3.53.4 is on the fixed upstream lineage.
The production root anchor/service path remains unverified; F-V01-13 is therefore not closed.
Draft #440/#466 root provision logic performed pathlib mkdir followed by chown/chmod before the lstat-based secure-chain rejection.
generated_reality: Eventual symlink denial in the privileged root provisioner might be sufficient because the path would fail before committed SQLite/anchor publication.
counter_reality: Pathlib metadata operations may follow a symlink and mutate a caller-selected victim before the later secure-chain check denies the path, violating fail-closed-before-effect semantics.
causal_mechanism: The old _ensure_root_secure_dir sequence called os.chown(path) and os.chmod(path) before _assert_root_secure_chain(path). chown/chmod follow directory symlinks by default, while the later lstat check detects the symlink only after those privileged effects.

unusual_experiment.name: PRECHECK_SYMLINK_SIDE_EFFECT
unusual_experiment.scope: Disposable local root-owned filesystem only; no production or canonical Frank state.
unusual_experiment.baseline: A normal root-owned directory was admitted by the legacy helper.
unusual_experiment.treatment: A disposable symlink path referenced a root-owned victim directory initially mode 0700.
unusual_experiment.setup_note: An initial placement under /var/tmp was rejected by the existing world-writable-parent policy; the same experiment was completed under /root. This is one experiment, not an additional branch.
unusual_experiment.observed: The treatment was eventually denied as SECURE_CHAIN_SYMLINK_FORBIDDEN, but the victim mode changed 0700 -> 0755 before denial.

changes: Traverse/create deployment directory components through directory FDs with O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW.
Reject existing symlink, non-root-owned, or group/world-writable components before privileged metadata mutation.
Only mutate newly created directory FDs with fchown/fchmod and fsync before continuing.
Use no-follow directory fsync and include file metadata changes in the durability point.
Port the exact #444 artifact-authority pin from draft #466 onto fresh main.
Add deterministic regression requiring symlink denial with victim mode unchanged.
repair.rollback: Drop/close PR #486; no production deployment was performed.

grf_collapse.retained_reality: Root deployment path authority must be established before root metadata effects; eventual rejection after following a symlink is insufficient.
grf_collapse.refuted_reality: Eventual secure-chain denial alone makes the old privileged helper fail-closed.
grf_collapse.strongest_remaining_counter_reality: Even a correct root provisioner does not prove the productive service parent, fixed-runtime mapping, root anchor installation, rollback/downgrade/library-swap continuity, canonical WAL-state migration, or semantic lineage recovery.
grf_collapse.confidence: HIGH for local mechanism defect and repair direction; LOW/UNKNOWN for production acceptance until target evidence exists.
